S1314.reason: Deliberate cultivation and domestication began with the Neolithic about 12,000–10,000 years ago, so the matching window is the past 12,000 years.

S0967.reason: Flight recorders are painted bright international orange so searchers can spot them; “black box” is only the nickname.

S0539.reason: Pizarro’s force was tiny; Inca subject peoples lacked loyalty to Cuzco and the empire was split by civil war, so local allies mattered more than horses, guns, or numbers.

S0458.reason: Upper Paleolithic exchange was mostly long-distance exotic items, while Mesolithic exchange moved a wider range of goods over shorter regional distances.

S1091.reason: The New Palace peak on Crete runs from the earthquake that ended the Old Palaces (~1700 BCE / 3650 BP) to the Thera eruption that shattered them (~1470 BCE / 3420 BP).
